step1.title: Generate Attestation Document
step1.intro: Request an attestation document from the Nitro Enclave. Optionally include a nonce for freshness.

step2.title: Attestation Verification
step2.intro: Verifying COSE signature, certificate chain, and extracting enclave public key — all in your browser.
step2.certChainHint: Click any certificate to view its details and PEM content.

step3.title: Secure Message Echo (HPKE)
step3.info: Your message is encrypted using HPKE (RFC 9180) with the enclave's verified P-256 public key. The enclave decrypts it, processes it, and sends back an encrypted response that only you can decrypt.
step3.messageLabel: Secret message to encrypt and send to enclave
step3.messagePlaceholder: Type your secret message here... The enclave will echo it back encrypted.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Overview
infrastructure.description: Full system architecture: Browser → Cognito → API Gateway → VPC Link → NLB → EC2 inbound proxy → vsock → Nitro Enclave, with automated CI/CD pipeline.

flow.label: Attestation Flow
flow.title: Attestation & HPKE Encryption Flow
flow.description: Complete sequence: authentication → attestation generation → client-side verification → HPKE encrypted communication. Plaintext never travels over the network.

cicd.label: CI/CD Pipeline
cicd.title: CI/CD Pipeline
cicd.description: Automated deployment: upload source → EventBridge triggers CodePipeline → CodeBuild creates the EIF → CodeDeploy rolls out to EC2 with zero downtime.

security.hpkeText: Hybrid Public Key Encryption with DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256) + AES-128-GCM
security.e2eText: Plaintext NEVER travels over the network — encrypted in browser, decrypted only in enclave
security.browserText: Attestation documents verified entirely in browser using COSE/CBOR
security.keyText: HPKE private key generated and kept only within the Nitro Enclave memory
security.chainText: Full verification against AWS Nitro Root CA (P-384)
security.biText: Responses encrypted using HPKE exported keys, decrypted in browser
security.ztText: Fully private VPC with no NAT Gateway — VPC Endpoints only
security.cicdText: S3 → EventBridge → CodePipeline → CodeBuild → CodeDeploy lifecycle
